title: juicy unfried french tod fritters
description: floral and juicy tod fritters infused with yuzu, perfect for adventurous french cuisine lovers. for a halal-friendly option, be sure to choose a halal certification for your ingredient suppliers.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use a high-protein flour for best results

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use flaky sea salt for the best flavor

instructions: in a blender or food processor, blend zucchini, yuzu juice, and ricotta cheese until smooth.
in a large bowl, whisk together flour, eggs, and a pinch of salt until just combined.
add the blended zucchini mixture to the flour mixture and stir until just combined.
cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the mixture to firm up.
heat 1/4 cup of grapeseed oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the mixture into the hot oil and flatten slightly with a spatula.
cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
transfer the fritters to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
garnish with chopped fresh mint leaves and serve immediately.
repeat with the remaining mixture, cooking in batches as needed.
serve the fritters hot, with your favorite dipping sauce on the side.
